2608.05115.title: Robust and Efficient Motion Reasoning for Privacy-Aware Classroom Incident Recognition
2608.05115.paper_summary: Can computer vision help make classrooms safer? In this pilot study, we investigate privacy-aware and computationally efficient classroom incident recognition from CCTV-style observations. This setting remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and few methods designed for the privacy, efficiency, and generalization demands of real-world deployment. We introduce a novel hybrid benchmark combining generative CCTV-style videos with real-world classroom pose data, and propose a lightweight, but robust motion-reasoning framework motivated by the observation that many incidents differ more in motion direction, speed, acceleration, and intensity than in pose alone. To that end, our method first constructs hierarchical kinematic representations of human actions. Our method then distills hierarchical, multi-order kinematic reasoning from a large teacher into a much smaller single-order student, enabling efficient per-person inference while preserving expressive motion understanding. Experiments show that our model outperforms substantially larger baselines at less than one-tenth of their computational cost, while also demonstrating stronger out-of-domain motion reasoning and zero-shot synthetic-to-real generalization. We will publicly release the benchmark, codebase, and supporting tools to facilitate further research in privacy-aware classroom safety.
2608.05115.paper_summary_zh: 電腦視覺能否幫助使教室更安全？在這項試點研究中，我們調查了從 CCTV 風格觀察中進行隱私意識和計算效率的教室事件識別。這一領域仍然未被充分探索，基準有限，且針對現實世界部署的隱私、效率和泛化需求設計的方法不多。我們引入了一個新穎的混合基準，將生成的 CCTV 風格視頻與真實世界的教室姿勢數據相結合，並提出了一個輕量級但穩健的運動推理框架，這是基於觀察到許多事件在運動方向、速度、加速度和強度上差異更大，而不僅僅是姿勢。為此，我們的方法首先構建了人類行為的分層運動學表示。然後，我們的方法從一個大型教師中提煉出分層的多階運動學推理，轉化為一個更小的單階學生，從而實現每個人的高效推斷，同時保持表達豐富的運動理解。實驗表明，我們的模型在計算成本不到其十分之一的情況下，顯著超越了更大基準，同時也展示了更強的域外運動推理和零樣本合成到真實的泛化。我們將公開發布基準、代碼庫和支持工具，以促進在隱私意識教室安全方面的進一步研究。
